milestone.title: M146 follow-up: retire the spec_status / execution_status legacy aliases

intent.outcome: raul milestones, raul show, and raul spec stop carrying the legacy Spec/Exec columns and instead show a single Lifecycle column. mp status drops the by_execution_status / by_spec_status aliases from its JSON output. The Board lane (kanban view) classifies cards from lifecycle + the blocked/deferred/cancelled overlays instead of the legacy spec/exec pair. After this lands, the M100 'kept for backcompat during the migration window' can finally close and the spec_status / execution_status fields drop from the on-disk MilestoneMeta entirely.

problem.description: M146 collapsed the TUI Plan-overview block to the canonical lifecycle rollup and added the set-lifecycle mutator, but the deferred work in M146 commit 8a3d1e2 is still open: (1) the raul CLI list / show / spec tables still read the legacy spec_status / execution_status fields and render two badges, (2) the mp status JSON output still emits the by_execution_status and by_spec_status keys alongside by_lifecycle, (3) the Board lane classification in crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs::classify_card still keys on the legacy fields. These are the last three surfaces where a user can still see the legacy vocabulary after the migration. Each one of them is small in isolation but they all share the M100 spec_status/execution_status → lifecycle migration; doing them together lets the alias fields drop from the model in a single follow-up.

in_scope: Update raul milestones (list) column headers to render one Lifecycle column instead of Spec / Exec. The colour pipeline (status_role in crates/raul/src/config.rs) already maps both legacy and lifecycle values correctly, so this is a label change.

Update raul show <id> to render one Lifecycle badge. The Spec / Exec meta rows become a single row that reads the lifecycle field (with legacy-aliases fallback only when the canonical field is empty, mirroring the TUI detail fallback in M146).
Update raul spec <id> to render one Lifecycle + Review badge (drop the legacy Spec and Exec).

Update crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs::build_board_columns + classify_card to read lifecycle + the blocked / deferred / cancelled overlays instead of spec_status / execution_status. The Board card data class (crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs::BoardCard) drops spec_status / execution_status fields. Classify_card's signature is simplified.

Update crates/mp/src/commands/status.rs to drop the by_execution_status and by_spec_status keys from the milestones block in the mp status JSON output. Update tests/fixtures/json-shape/status.json golden accordingly. The lanes block (path_engine::build_lanes) is the canonical source for execution-stage counts; consumers that need them use that block.

Mark the spec_status / execution_status fields on MilestoneMeta + MilestoneFile as `#[serde(rename = "_deprecated_spec_status")]` or move them under a #[serde(default, skip_serializing)] marker so they no longer appear in the wire format. Keep reading them on the in-memory struct so the migration window continues to read correctly from pre-M146 files.

Add a `mp milestone migrate-legacy-fields` command (or a flag on the existing `mp migrate-lifecycle`) that scrubs the legacy fields from disk for milestones that have already been M100-migrated. Bulk-roll across the repo after the wire-format drop. The migration is idempotent.
out_of_scope: Removing the migration-helper functions legacy_spec_status_to_lifecycle / legacy_execution_status_to_lifecycle — those stay around as long as there are on-disk files that still carry the legacy fields. The followup-after-this-one milestone retires them once the wire-format is gone.
Updating the doc surface (master-plan config files, fixtures) — the wire-format change is the contract change; documentation follows from that.

acceptance_criteria.description: raul milestones (list) renders one Lifecycle column instead of Spec / Exec. Verified by the tui_render / milestones list tests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p raul --test tui_render passed and the rendered table shows one Lifecycle column instead of Spec/Exec.

acceptance_criteria.description: raul show <id> renders one Lifecycle badge. The legacy Spec / Exec row collapses to a single Lifecycle row, with a fallback to the legacy pair only when the milestone has never been migrated.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p raul --test tui_render passed and the meta block in show output reads a single Lifecycle row.

acceptance_criteria.description: raul spec <id> renders one Lifecycle + Review badge pair, dropping the legacy Spec / Exec columns.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p raul --test spec_review passed and spec output drops Spec/Exec, keeps Lifecycle + Review.

acceptance_criteria.description: mp status JSON output drops the by_execution_status and by_spec_status keys under milestones. The by_lifecycle rollup remains the canonical source. Golden fixture regenerated.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p mp --test suite_misc status_shape_stable passed and the milestones block in status output has only by_lifecycle.

acceptance_criteria.description: crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs::classify_card classifies from the lifecycle field plus the blocked / deferred / cancelled overlays. The pre-M146 spec/exec branches are removed. crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs::BoardCard drops spec_status / execution_status fields.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p raul --test board_view passed and the board classification reads from lifecycle + overlays, not spec_status / execution_status.

acceptance_criteria.description: mp milestone migrate-legacy-fields scrubs the legacy alias fields from disk for already-migrated milestones, with --dry-run support and an idempotent implementation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Verified end-to-end: cargo test -p mp --test suite_milestone passed and the new field runs end-to-end and migration is idempotent.

design_decisions.choice: Strip the legacy alias fields from the on-disk JSON shape with a one-release migration: keep the in-memory struct fields readable so pre-M146 files still load, but the JSON shape after M155 carries only the canonical  field plus the  /  /  overlays.
design_decisions.rationale: Two-step approach (wire-format drop, then in-memory struct field drop) lets external scripts that read the legacy keys see a clean removal in one release rather than a feature-by-feature drain. The migration is idempotent and migrate-legacy-fields rolls across the repo in one pass.
